entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, my name is David Chen. The order number is VF881-92B.
Thank you, David. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Grip cycling shoes, delivered on January 8th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's them. I feel terrible about this, I've been a loyal customer for years.

We appreciate your loyalty, David, and I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but after my first real ride in them, they gave me awful blisters. I just can't wear them. I was so excited, and I really needed this money back if they didn't work out.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I understand completely. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Okay. I just hope I can get a refund. I know I wore them once, but they're basically new.

Not a problem at all, David. I've checked the policy, and since you received the cycling shoes just 17 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Of course. I'm glad I could help. I have just initiated that return for you. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just place the shoes back in the box, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. You've been so helpful. Thank you.
You're very welcome, David. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
